items.title: Konitz Lee — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: That one Laren gig was I think the only European thing I did with that band.

ctx.x: Those are the four records that I know of. Somebody gave me a CD of the concert you did at the Smithsonian. That’s early eighties.
That one Laren gig was I think the only European thing I did with that band.
But it lasted a while. Then I remember you did the Vanguard with it sometime in the early eighties so it lasted for the better part of ten years actually. What’s your feelings about it?
